hero.title: Music Story
hero.summary: Music Story is a professional provider of music metadata and enrichment services for B2B players: media, platforms, and rights holders. I participated in the redesign of their showcase website by upgrading a heterogeneous WordPress base to a more modern Next.js platform, built on reusable components and deployed iteratively with code reviews alongside the team. This redesign made the site faster and more consistent, fully internationalized and better referenced, while simplifying maintenance and speeding up the creation of new pages and their publication online.

hero.title: Paris 92
hero.summary:
Paris 92 is a women's handball club recognized on the national and European scene that seeks to optimize the management and analysis of its data. 
 I participated in the design and implementation of a secure platform that centralizes match data, videos, and physical metrics, in collaboration with five students from ISEN. My role was that of a versatile front/back developer with a Next.js interface and Python back-end for data processing. 
 This platform allows coaches, analysts, and trainers to track workload, compare performance, prepare for matches, and generate reports in just a few clicks, which streamlines collaboration, makes information gathering more reliable, and speeds up decision-making. 
 The code and deliverables are confidential, but you can ask me about them!

hero.title: MedChem Structure Genius
hero.summary:
MedChem Structure Genius is an e-learning application designed for students at the Faculty of Pharmacy at the University of Lille to help them study molecules and their relationships. 
In collaboration with a team of five students from ISEN, I am leading this project by defining the client's needs, facilitating weekly meetings, and ensuring follow-up while contributing directly to development. 
We are improving the reliability and usability of the application: fixing display bugs on Android and the web, resolving quiz generation errors, improving the review and score tracking interfaces, optimizing the code, correcting texts, and creating an explanatory diagram of the quiz generation mechanism and typical queries on Supabase to facilitate data exploration. 
The project is still in progress, so feel free to ask me any questions you may have!
